crossRefs.note: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good…
one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
(but how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule one’s own house take care of God’s assembly?)

translations.web: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
translations.bsb: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
translations.asv: Let deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
